title: Access Delegation Studio — Audit Replay & Cost Attribution Canvas
creator: Asha Mehta
description: Design a consolidated "Access Delegation Studio" in the Redwood Console that lets admins: record delegated access handoffs, replay recent access changes in a timeline (audit-replay), and surface per-decision cost attribution for actions that affect inference spend (e.g., role-based rollout triggering dedicated capacity). The goal is a single Canvas-style surface where reviewers can see who enabled what, replay the change in context, attach approvals or rollbacks, and understand downstream cost impact. This ticket covers low-fidelity -> high-fidelity prototype, two rounds of stakeholder review, and handoff artifacts for engineering and PM.
acceptance_criteria: Canvas prototype (Figma) with three panes: Timeline (audit events), Replay (step-through context), Cost Impact (tokenized cost estimates) linked
Interaction flows for: propose delegation, approve/decline, attach evidence, and rollback with explicit audit note
Accessibility review checklist completed (keyboard, color contrast, screen reader labels)
Handoff package includes component spec, animations, state variants, and edge-case error states
Engineering sign-off on data contract for audit event payload and cost attribution matrix
comments: 2025-02-12 Asha Mehta: Kickoff — sketched three candidate layouts: split-vertical, canvas-overlay, and modal-stepper. PM prefers canvas for combined comprehension. Decided to explore canvas + detachable panel pattern.
2025-02-18 Liam O'Connor: Low-fi review complete. Opted to collapse repetitive meta fields in timeline entries and surface cost delta only for changes that touch Dedicated/Dynamic routing policies.
2025-02-21 Priya Nair (PM): Requested clear guardrails for rollbacks — must show dependent resources and impacted workspaces. Added as acceptance criteria.
2025-02-24 Eng sync (Ravi Kumar): Data contract questions — backend needs to return aggregated token cost per ACL change and list of affected model routes. ENG-22033 created to add API fields.
2025-02-26 Accessibility review (Nora Liu): Color palette adjustments for contrast; keyboard focus order updated. Marking 'a11y' ready for final QA.
2025-02-28 Design crit with Security (Marta Silva): Security suggests masking user identifiers when viewed by auditors outside workspace. Decided to add scope toggle: 'Full IDs / pii-redacted'.
2025-03-01 Liam O'Connor: High-fi uploaded and ready for PM review. Added micro-interaction specs and animations for replay scrubber. Seeking eng estimate on animation perf impact.
decisions: Adopt canvas + detachable panel pattern to allow auditors to float the replay window while scanning timeline
Show cost impact only for events that change serving routing or capacity commitments to avoid noise
Add 'scope toggle' to redact PII for cross-team auditors; default to redacted outside owner workspace
Rollback action will create a linked audit event and require explicit justification (free-text) and 2-step confirmation
tradeoffs: Showing cost deltas for every event increases cognitive load; tradeoff: surface deltas only on hover/expand
Real-time replay of old requests requires snapshotting request context — increases backend storage; compromise: replay contextual metadata and sampled request payloads
Animations improve comprehension but may affect perceived latency — we provide a 'reduced motion' preference
reviews: 2025-02-20 Design Crit: positive on visual hierarchy; requested better affordances for linking events to PRs and dashboards
2025-02-24 Security Review: conditional approval pending 'scope toggle' implementation and audit logging of view events
2025-02-27 Engineering Review: blocking question about cost attribution frequency; ENG recommended hourly aggregation for historical events
2025-03-01 PM Review: minor copy edits and request to include 'who will be notified' preview when delegating access
open_questions: Should cost attribution show modeled estimates or exact historical spend? (PM prefers modeled for fast UX; Finance prefers exact)
Where should archived replay artifacts live and retention window? (security leaning toward 1 year minimum)
Do we allow non-admins to trigger rollback with approval, or restrict to workspace admins?
